search_text: published ZDI-09-045 ZDI-CAN-389 Microsoft DirectShow Quicktime Atom Parsing Memory Corruption Vulnerability 2009-07-14 CVE-2009-1539 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-1539 ['Microsoft', 'Microsoft', 'Microsoft'] ['Windows 2000', 'Windows XP', 'Windows Server 2003'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Windows. User interaction is required in that a target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious video file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of the length records of certain QuickTime atoms. The application implicitly trusts the length during a transformation which will lead to memory corruption and can be leveraged to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current user.
